name: Tessellation

frame.name: Property: Undecidable
frame.description: This [weapon|instrument|topology] adapts its damage type to match your equipped grenade. Final blows grant grenade and Transcendence energy.

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.description:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Property: Irreducible
perks.description: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume your grenade to load a large [projectile|shape|language] that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

flavor: The monolith is hewn; the monument is built.

catalyst.name: Tessellation Catalyst
catalyst.description: Targets near the blast of Property: Irreducible are [afflicted|burdened|cursed] with an elemental effect matching your equipped grenade's damage type.
